close_reason: Rewrote Inner::recompute_calendars_with_events as the iterator chain proposed by the reviewer. No more .cloned() on the CalendarEvent map; the immutable borrow of self.objects ends at the .collect() so the mutable borrow via self.aux_mut() proceeds cleanly. cargo test/clippy/doc all green. Scoped to calendars-server only — no other sibling has an analogous derived-index path, so no propagation needed.
title: recompute_calendars_with_events clones the full CalendarEvent map to escape the borrow checker
